name: Longshore
descriptionSeed: Longshore — the waygate town: outfitters, bridge-wrights, and people who know how long a road really takes. Everyone here is either leaving or has just arrived, and it is the one place on any road where nobody asks where you are from. ⚠️ AND THE NAME IS NOT ABOUT THIS TOWN. Longshore is a mountain town at seventy-seven above the sea and four hundred and ninety-six miles from it; the shore in its name is the one at the far end of the road that starts here. THE LONG SHORE-ROAD — twenty-six days outward to Firstsight, seven more down the Outrun to Keelmouth and a hull. People arrive expecting a harbour about twice a season. The outfitters have stopped correcting them and started selling them boots.
encounterFlavor: traders, apprentices and people from three domains who have learned to share a street
questSeeds: Someone has arrived expecting to hire a ship today, has paid for a berth that does not exist, and the outfitter who sold it is still in town
A keel-wright's letter from Keelmouth has been waiting at the wayhouse for two years
axisVectorNote: Derived from authored spectrum against world_node_atlas.axisOrder (SNG-180). ⚠️ Every component is |0.45| or less by construction: a foothill is not extreme on any axis, which is what distinguishes it from its pole capital.
worldPosNote: ⚠️ THE LITERAL MIDPOINT between the Crossing and the_long_span, taking the short way round on longitude. The world position states the philosophy: a foothill sits half the distance out from the centre toward its pole, and the geography and the fiction say the same thing.
nameNote: ⛔ SNG-537, ratified by Erik 2026-09-11. MEASURED: biome `mountain`, elevation 205 against a sea level of 128 (+77), 416mi from the nearest sea, and its own namesake river The Longshore Water runs 174mi away and never touches it. ⚠️ THE GM HAD ALREADY TOLD A PLAYER OTHERWISE — Brynjar, in a live save: 'Longshore is the nearest deep-water hire port.' Nothing lied and nobody authored a port; the word *shore* was the only field carrying a claim and the GM read it, which is what a good reader does with the only evidence it has. ⛔ THE FIX IS NOT A RENAME AND NOT A MOVE. Longshore is the seat of `foothill_longshore` and terrain.json's voter array is baked and in sync across all 38 seats — moving a seat desyncs it, and terrain must not be rebuilt (Erik: 'the world stays as it is basically'). So the name becomes true instead: the long shore-road BEGINS here. Every existing line in the save survives, Brynjar's included, as the half-truth a waypoint-keeper would actually tell.
